methodology_pages.name: Billionaire Mindset Track
methodology_pages.definition: A background decision filter that evaluates opportunities through ownership, leverage, asymmetric upside, and downside containment.

methodology_pages.name: High-Pressure Coaching Mode
methodology_pages.definition: A direct coaching mode that challenges avoidance, false constraints, and comfort-seeking when the user needs pressure-tested clarity.

methodology_pages.name: Executive Review Mode
methodology_pages.definition: A review-only mode that organizes what the user already knows without introducing new theories or resetting the system.

methodology_pages.name: Never Miss Twice
methodology_pages.definition: A continuity rule that treats one missed day as data and prevents a second missed day from becoming drift.

methodology_pages.name: Minimum Viable Day
methodology_pages.definition: A reduced-scope execution protocol that preserves continuity when energy, mood, or pressure makes a full day unrealistic.

methodology_pages.name: No Catch-Up
methodology_pages.definition: A recovery law that closes missed work instead of turning yesterday into punishment.

methodology_pages.name: Arbitration Engine
methodology_pages.definition: A priority-selection method that chooses the foreground project by comparing leverage, urgency, energy match, compounding value, and downside.

methodology_pages.name: Three-Chat Architecture
methodology_pages.definition: A separation model that keeps source-of-truth rules, daily runtime, and governance edits in distinct LLM conversations.

methodology_pages.name: Foreground Priority
methodology_pages.definition: The single active project that receives the user’s highest creative and execution energy during the current operating window.

methodology_pages.name: Daily Agenda Engine
methodology_pages.definition: A daily sequencing system that converts goals, constraints, and energy into a clear execution stack inside an LLM.
